Dry Pipe Alarm Valve
A differential-type water control valve for dry-pipe sprinkler systems in unheated or freezing environments. The downstream piping is kept charged with air or nitrogen instead of water; when a sprinkler opens and the system air pressure drops, the valve opens and floods the piping with water.
